title: Reverse Holo Flabebe 091/198 Common SV Scarlet & Violet Base Set Pokemon TCG
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Reverse Holo Flabebe card is a great addition to any Pokémon TCG collection. With a card number of 091/198, it features the Stage 1 character Flabébé from the Base Set. The card has a Common rarity and is not autographed. 

The card's finish is Reverse Holo, which makes it a unique and sought-after item. It is perfect for collectors and players alike. Add this card to your collection today and watch as Flabébé evolves into Blumebé right before your eyes!
